title: Private parts of a public document
about: A key applies to the node it is put on and everything beneath it; nested keys are both needed, and something made from a private node is only as visible as that node.

args: public, but made from the private note

checks.name: without a key only the public part shows

nested keys are both needed: Bob's alone shows nothing private
Alice's and Bob's keys show everything
